name: 🐦 Magpie
author: dreinecke (fork of huacnlee/omamail)
description: Mail for Omarchy with single-pane and split layouts and independent interface, list and message fonts.

barWidget.description: Unread Gmail count in the bar; the inbox opens in its own window.

schema.label: Show the icon in the bar
schema.description: Turn this off to run Magpie with no envelope in the bar. Mail is still checked and still notifies; only the icon goes. With it off the window opens from a keybinding or a terminal and nowhere else, so bind a key first: o.bind("SUPER + SHIFT + G", "Magpie", "omarchy shell shell toggle magpie '{}'")

schema.label: Check for mail every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the unread count is refreshed while the panel is closed.

schema.label: Heavy message rendering
schema.description: Choose whether potentially expensive rich text falls back to plain text with a Show anyway action.

schema.label: Message direction
schema.description: Which way a message's own text runs. Auto reads it from the text itself, so an Arabic, Hebrew or Persian message lays out right-to-left and an English one does not. Set a direction to use that one for every message. The interface itself is unaffected.

schema.label: Default search
schema.description: Applies to the inbox only, and to Gmail and IMAP accounts. Gmail takes any Gmail search operator, for example `in:inbox -category:promotions`; IMAP takes IMAP SEARCH criteria. HEY accounts always open their Imbox.

schema.label: AI agent
schema.description: Agent for new mail chats and calendar suggestions. System default follows Omarchy; unsupported defaults disable AI. Changing the selection starts fresh chats and keeps previous chats read-only. Requires backend API 6.

schema.label: AI model (optional)
schema.description: Leave blank for the selected agent's default model. OpenCode takes provider/model or provider/model#variant; Codex and Claude take their model names. Changing the model starts fresh chats and keeps previous chats read-only. Requires backend API 6.

schema.label: Suggest calendar events from mail
schema.description: Uses the selected AI agent and model: a message from a person that names a time is sent to it once when opened, which spends tokens. Notifications, newsletters and lists are skipped. Nothing is written until you Add.

schema.label: Notify on new mail
schema.description: Sends a desktop notification when a new unread message arrives in the inbox.

schema.label: Sign-in callback port
schema.description: Loopback port used once during Google sign-in. HEY and IMAP accounts never use it. Change it only if something else already listens there.

schema.label: Undo send window (seconds)
schema.description: Delays outgoing mail so you can cancel it. Set this to 0 to send immediately.

schema.label: Clicking the bar icon opens
schema.description: The full window, or a small card with the most recent unread mail.
